title: C: Middleware Pipeline
description: Implement a middleware pipeline where each handler can process a request and optionally pass it to the next handler.

steps.title: Middleware Chain
steps.description: Define a `Handler` struct with a function pointer `int (*handle)(char *req)` and a next handler pointer. Implement a logging middleware that prints the request, an auth middleware that checks if req contains 'token', and a final handler that processes the request.
hints: Each handler calls `next->handle(req)` if next exists.
Logging: print req, then call next.
Auth: check for 'token', return 0 if missing.

verification.failureMessage: Run full middleware chain and print results
